children: Trilogy Metals announced definitive agreements with the U.S. Department of War to advance the Ambler Access Project. The Investment Agreement provides $17.8 million via the sale of 8,215,570 units at $2.17 per unit, including warrants for up to 6,161,678 shares at $0.01, exercisable upon specified milestones for ten years. In a related transaction, the Investor will pay $17.8 million to South32 for shares and a call option, with total proceeds of about $35.6 million to be reinvested in Ambler Metals. A separate Cooperation Agreement among Trilogy Metals US, South32 USA, Ambler Metals and the Investor sets frameworks for permitting, financing collaboration and security protocols, with observer and information rights for the Investor.
